title: Review Tipper Alarm History on Operator Station HMI (Visu_Alarm)
summary: Use the Operator Station HMI Visu_Alarm screen to view the list of tipper alarms with timestamps, then press SHOW HISTORY to load the last 1500 alarm records for live troubleshooting of tipper faults.
when_to_use: When you need to review tipper alarm entries and their timestamps on the Operator Station HMI, including accessing the last 1500 alarm records via SHOW HISTORY to support investigation of a tipper fault.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate to the Visu_Alarm screen, load alarm history using SHOW HISTORY, and record the relevant alarm entry/entries and timestamps for the tipper fault being investigated.
access_or_tools_needed: Operator Station HMI access to the "Visu_Alarm" screen
Ability to click the "SHOW HISTORY" button

access_required: Operator Station HMI access to the "Visu_Alarm" screen

visual_references.description: Operator Station HMI Visu_Alarm screen showing the list of tipper alarms with timestamps and the SHOW HISTORY button.

steps.title: Open the Operator Station HMI screen "Visu_Alarm"
steps.purpose: Get to the screen that lists tipper alarms with timestamps.
steps.instruction: On the Operator Station HMI, open the screen named "Visu_Alarm".
steps.expected_result: The Visu_Alarm screen is displayed and ready to show the tipper alarm list.
steps.healthy_condition: The Visu_Alarm screen is visible as the Operator Station HMI alarms screen.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot reach the Visu_Alarm screen (screen not found / not displayed).

steps.title: Verify the alarm list shows tipper alarms with timestamps
steps.purpose: Confirm the screen is populated with the expected alarm entries and timestamp field before loading history.
steps.instruction: On the Visu_Alarm screen, verify the list of tipper alarms is displayed and that each alarm entry includes a timestamp.
steps.expected_result: A list of tipper alarms is visible, and each entry includes a timestamp.
steps.healthy_condition: Alarm entries are present and each row shows a timestamp.
steps.failure_condition: The alarm list is empty or alarm entries do not show timestamps.

actions.label: Check alarm list and timestamps
actions.exact_action: Verify the screen shows a list of tipper alarms and that each entry includes a timestamp.

steps.title: Click SHOW HISTORY to load alarm history
steps.purpose: Load the historical alarm records so you can review the most recent 1500 entries.
steps.instruction: On the Visu_Alarm screen, click the "SHOW HISTORY" button.
steps.expected_result: The screen switches/updates to show the alarm history view.
steps.healthy_condition: The history view loads successfully after pressing SHOW HISTORY.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing SHOW HISTORY does not populate the history view.

actions.label: Load history
actions.exact_action: Click the "SHOW HISTORY" button to load the alarm history.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the alarm list is empty or timestamps/entries do not populate after pressing SHOW HISTORY, stop and escalate to support for further investigation of tipper alarm reporting.

steps.title: Confirm the history shows up to the last 1500 alarm records
steps.purpose: Ensure you are viewing the expected history capacity for accurate troubleshooting.
steps.instruction: In the history view, confirm the list expands to include historical entries up to the last 1500 alarm records.
steps.expected_result: The history view shows up to the last 1500 alarm records.
steps.healthy_condition: The history list expands to include historical entries up to the 1500-record capacity.
steps.failure_condition: The history view does not expand to include historical entries up to the last 1500 records.

actions.label: Check history capacity
actions.exact_action: Confirm the history view shows up to the last 1500 alarm records.

steps.title: Record the relevant alarm entry/entries and timestamps
steps.purpose: Capture the exact alarm identity and time so the tipper fault investigation can be correlated to events.
steps.instruction: Stop on the relevant alarm entry/entries for the tipper fault you are investigating and record the alarm identity exactly as displayed on the list and the associated timestamp.
steps.expected_result: You have recorded the alarm identity/identity(ies) and their associated timestamps from the Visu_Alarm history list.
steps.healthy_condition: Recorded entries correspond to visible alarm rows and their timestamps in the history view.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot identify the relevant alarm row(s) or timestamps are missing/unclear.

actions.label: Record alarm row(s)
actions.exact_action: Stop and record the relevant alarm entry/entries (alarm identity as displayed on the list and the associated timestamp) for the tipper fault you are investigating.

success_criteria: Visu_Alarm shows a list of tipper alarms with timestamps.
After pressing SHOW HISTORY, the history view shows up to the last 1500 alarm records.
The operator records the relevant alarm identity/identity(ies) and associated timestamp(s) for the tipper fault under investigation.
healthy_conditions: Visu_Alarm alarm list entries include timestamps.
SHOW HISTORY loads the last 1500 alarm records into the history view.
failure_conditions: Timestamps/entries do not populate after pressing SHOW HISTORY.
History view does not show up to the last 1500 alarm records.
escalation_guidance: If the alarm list is empty or timestamps/entries do not populate after pressing SHOW HISTORY, stop and escalate to support for further investigation of tipper alarm reporting.
